text: ユウと　いっしょなら　もう　まける　きが　しないのさ！

structure.jp: ユウと　いっしょなら
もう　まける　きが　しないのさ！
structure.en: I don't feel like I could lose anymore!

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.span: まける　きが　しない
patterns.explanation: きがする after a verb means 'have the feeling that'; with しない it is 'don't have the feeling that'. まける　きが　しない = 'I don't feel like I'll lose'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if it is the case that'. いっしょなら = 'if we're together'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の gives an explaining tone and さ adds a breezy, confident male ring. しないのさ = 'I don't, you see!'.
